title: Valid Parentheses
description: Determine if an input string containing only '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']' is valid. A string is valid if open brackets are closed by the same type of brackets in the correct order, and every close bracket has a corresponding open bracket.

steps.note: Start `isValid` function for input string `s = "([{}])"`.
Initialize an empty stack to keep track of opening brackets.
Define a map for closing brackets to their corresponding opening brackets.
Start iterating through the input string. Current character `s[0]` is '('.
Check if current character '(' is an opening bracket. It is.
Push '(' onto the stack.
Move to the next character. Current character `s[1]` is '['.
Check if current character '[' is an opening bracket. It is.
Push '[' onto the stack.
Move to the next character. Current character `s[2]` is '{'.
Check if current character '{' is an opening bracket. It is.
Push '{' onto the stack.
Move to the next character. Current character `s[3]` is '}'.
Check if current character '}' is an opening bracket. It is not.
Check if current character '}' is a closing bracket. It is.
Check if the stack is empty. It is not (length is 3).
Pop the top element from the stack. Popped: '{'.
Compare `map['}']` ('{') with the popped element ('{'). They match. Continue.
Move to the next character. Current character `s[4]` is ']'.
Check if current character ']' is an opening bracket. It is not.
Check if current character ']' is a closing bracket. It is.
Check if the stack is empty. It is not (length is 2).
Pop the top element from the stack. Popped: '['.
Compare `map[']']` ('[') with the popped element ('['). They match. Continue.
Move to the next character. Current character `s[5]` is ')'.
Check if current character ')' is an opening bracket. It is not.
Check if current character ')' is a closing bracket. It is.
Check if the stack is empty. It is not (length is 1).
Pop the top element from the stack. Popped: '('.
Compare `map[')']` ('(') with the popped element ('('). They match. Continue.
All characters in the string have been processed. The loop finishes.
Check if the stack is empty. It is empty, so all brackets are validly matched. Return `true`.
